source_summary: Vertical ink-and-light-color Chinese landscape with layered mountains, misty water, rocky ravines, small pavilions, bridges, and foreground pines. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: central_spring_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the large central background mountain rising behind the lake, including its rounded ridges, cliff folds, scattered dark tree strokes, pale ochre-green washes, and mist-softened lower slopes. Exclude the left calligraphy and seals and avoid the separate foreground pine groups.
must_preserve: layered contour linework defining rounded ridges
dry-brush rock texture and hemp-fiber strokes
clusters of short dark vertical tree marks on slopes
soft ochre and greenish wash transitions
misty broken edges at the lower mountain base

motifs.name: right_misty_peak_chain
motifs.description: Isolate the faint mountain chain on the upper right behind the main massif, including pale peaks, soft ink washes, and cloud-like gaps between forms. Exclude red seals above and nearby inscription areas.
must_preserve: pale diluted ink silhouettes
soft-edged peak contours
mist gaps separating overlapping ridges
subtle warm wash under the distant hills
low contrast atmospheric brushwork

motifs.name: mid_right_hillside_village
motifs.description: Isolate the middle-right hillside with small roofed buildings nestled among trees, terraced slopes, rocks, and light mist openings. Include only the village cluster and its immediate hillside setting.
must_preserve: small dark roof geometry and wall lines
fine tree trunks and vertical foliage strokes
terraced hillside contour lines
rock texture around the buildings
light blank mist pockets between slope sections

motifs.name: middle_lake_mist_banks
motifs.description: Isolate the broad middle water and mist area stretching across the center-left, with pale horizontal wash bands, low banks, small shore trees, and distant shoreline contours. Avoid including the calligraphy above or the large foreground rocks below.
must_preserve: horizontal diluted ink water bands
soft empty-paper mist passages
thin shoreline contours
small reed and tree marks along the banks
subtle ochre wash at the water edges

motifs.name: left_cliff_pine_outcrop
motifs.description: Isolate the left foreground rocky cliff and windswept pine at its top, including the boulder face, dotted texture, twisted trunk, and sparse needle clusters. Exclude the nearby pavilion below and the central water expanse.
must_preserve: twisted pine trunk linework
short needle clusters radiating from branches
rounded cliff contour strokes
dark moss dots along rock seams
pale ochre wash on the rock planes

motifs.name: thatched_pavilion_among_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the small thatched pavilion or shelter in the lower-left middle valley, with its simple roof, posts, adjacent bamboo, and surrounding rounded rocks. Do not include the larger left cliff pine or unrelated lower bridge.
must_preserve: angular thatched roof outline
thin vertical support posts
light interior open space under the roof
nearby bamboo and brushy plant strokes
rounded enclosing rock forms with dry texture

motifs.name: foreground_pine_grove_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground pine grove on the right slope, including multiple pale trunks, branching limbs, dense dark needle sprays, and surrounding dotted hillside texture. Exclude the bridge below as much as possible.
must_preserve: interlacing pale pine trunks
dark clustered pine needles
branch fork linework
dense moss-dot texture on the slope
ochre-green hillside washes behind the trees

motifs.name: lower_arched_bridge_stream
motifs.description: Isolate the small arched bridge crossing the lower stream, with adjacent rocks, banks, and faint water marks. Include the immediate stream setting but not the tall pine trunks above or distant village.
must_preserve: single-arch bridge curve
thin rail and pier linework
rocks flanking the bridge
horizontal water strokes beneath
small dotted vegetation along the banks

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
